entries.good_example:
echo "BEGIN;" > run.sql
cat migration.sql >> run.sql
echo "COMMIT;" >> run.sql
psql -f run.sql
entries.rationale: If a migration fails halfway, the database is left in an inconsistent state. SS QLM forces explicit transaction blocks to ensure 'All or Nothing' schema changes.
Exporting passwords to the environment makes them visible to other processes. SS QLM prioritizes native credential files with strict permissions.
